title: Implement media upload handling for batch media library
description: Implement the server-side media upload handler: a Next.js API route that accepts image file uploads for a batch, stores them in the uploads/ directory with the original filename, and creates a media record in the database.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid filenames are rejected with 400 and helpful error message
Media records are created in the database via repository
Only image files are accepted (jpg, jpeg, png, webp)
Response includes the created media record

steps.description: Create API route for media upload
steps.details: Create `src/app/api/batches/[id]/media/route.ts`. Use Next.js's built-in `request.formData()` to handle multipart uploads. No external multer needed.
Validate filename matches `/^(hero|gallery|about|services|team)-(\w+)-([a-z0-9-]+)\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$/i`. Extract slot and industry from the filename. Return 400 with error message if invalid.

steps.description: Save file to disk and create DB record
steps.details: Save file: `fs.mkdirSync(uploadDir, { recursive: true })`, write file buffer to `uploads/{batchId}/{filename}`. Create media record: `createMedia({ id: randomUUID(), batchId, filename, slot, industry, path: fullPath, createdAt: Date.now() })`.
Send a test upload via curl: `curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/batches/{id}/media -F 'file=@hero-roofing-tiles.jpg'`. Verify file appears in uploads/ and media record is in the database.

technicalNotes: Limit file size to 10MB. Reject oversized files with 413.
The upload path returned in the media record should be relative to the project root for portability.
